opportunities.name: Postgraduate Studentships (PGSs)
eligibility_clues: Only full-time postgraduate students of the University are eligible
A full-time MPhil student will normally be awarded a Postgraduate Studentship
A full-time PhD student will normally be awarded either a PhD Fellowship or a Postgraduate Studentship
Awarded to support daily subsistence, tuition fee and other expenses
Normally will not exceed two academic years for MPhil, three for PhD with a relevant master's degree, and four for PhD without a relevant master's degree
No residency bar is printed in the PGS terms
MPhil/PhD in Data Science is on the programme list; published research areas include numerical and computational mathematics
opportunities.amount: HK$19,010 for an MPhil student; HK$19,280 for a PhD student before confirmation of candidature; and HK$19,660 for a PhD student after confirmation of candidature
opportunities.amount_note: Financial-support page: monthly stipend for 2026/27. March 2026 terms repeat those monthly rates and say a partial studentship at standard rates of 25%, 50% or 75% may be awarded. No 2027/28 stipend figure is printed.
opportunities.deadline_note: The studentship page does not print a separate closing date. Direct Admissions (2027-28) on the admission page: Main Round 1 September 2026 to 15 January 2027 (Hong Kong Time 11:59 p.m.) for September 2027; 1st Clearing Round 16 January to 30 April 2027; 2nd Clearing Round 1 May to 31 August 2027 for January 2028.
opportunities.match_rationale: This is the university-wide monthly studentship for full-time MPhil and PhD students, and the open direct-admission round is labelled 2027-28. The terms do not exclude a Hong Kong permanent resident. Lingnan has no mathematics department, but MPhil/PhD in Data Science publishes research areas in numerical and computational mathematics, applied mathematics, and mathematical optimisation, so this is the living-stipend route for that field.
opportunities.intake_relevance: Direct Admissions (2027-28) is the round open on the admission page. Printed stipend rates are labelled 2026/27.
restrictions: Full-time only
Programme list: the UGC no longer funds part-time students from 2009-10, and part-time students have to be self-financed
Teaching and/or research support duties of up to 12 hours per week on average; 6 hours per week on average in the final year
PGS recipients should not engage in employment except with approved exemption
HKPFS awardees are not awarded Postgraduate Studentships
Further awards depend on good performance and availability of funds

opportunities.name: Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme (HKPFS)
eligibility_clues: RGC: candidates seeking admission as new full-time PhD students at Lingnan, irrespective of their country of origin, prior work experience and ethnic background
Lingnan nominates applicants for the Fellowship
PhD only; MPhil is not covered
Monthly stipend for a maximum period of 3 years
For a normative study period of 4 years, Lingnan will offer the same level of fellowship and travel allowance for the fourth year
Applicants not offered the Fellowship may be considered for a Lingnan place with a Postgraduate Studentship
Financial-support page: from the 2027/28 admission intake, the full tuition fee for the whole normative study period of a PhD Fellowship awardee will be waived
opportunities.amount: monthly stipend of HK$28,700 (subject to annual review)
opportunities.amount_note: Lingnan HKPFS page labels this the 2026-27 monthly stipend, plus a conference/research-related travel allowance of up to HK$14,400 per year (subject to annual review), for a maximum of 3 years. The RGC index page prints an annual stipend of HK$344,400 (approximately US$44,150) and a travel allowance of HK$14,400 per year for the 2026/27 academic year, and says 400 PhD Fellowships will be awarded in 2027/28. No separate 2027/28 monthly rate is printed.
opportunities.deadline_note: Lingnan full application by 1 December 2026 (HKT 23:59). Initial application on the RGC system during 1 September to 1 December 2026 (HKT 12:00). Select HK PhD Fellowship Scheme (2027-28). No late application will be accepted.
opportunities.match_rationale: HKPFS is a monthly PhD stipend, the Lingnan round is explicitly 2027-28 and still open on 2026-10-13, and the RGC page does not bar applicants by country of origin. It is university-wide for Lingnan PhD programmes, including Data Science, whose published areas include numerical and computational mathematics. It is not an MPhil award.
opportunities.intake_relevance: Application type on the Lingnan page is HK PhD Fellowship Scheme (2027-28). Stipend text is labelled 2026-27 and subject to annual review.
restrictions: PhD only
Competitive nomination by Lingnan and selection by the RGC
HKPFS awardees are not awarded Postgraduate Studentships
PGS terms on teaching duties, employment restriction and annual leave are generally applied to HKPFS awardees
Local tuition-waiver page: students whose tuition fee is fully waived by any other scheme are no longer eligible for the government Tuition Waiver for Local RPg Students

opportunities.name: LU Presidential PhD Scholarship (Top-up package for HKPFS Awardees)
eligibility_clues: Top-up scholarship for outstanding candidates admitted through the RGC's HKPFS
Applicable to HKPFS awardees for the 2027/28 admission intake
Award of HK$40,000 per year for the entire duration of study, up to four years of the normative study period
Full waiver of tuition fees for the whole normative study period
Eligibility to apply for an additional performance-based scholarship of up to HK$60,000 per year
Guaranteed hostel accommodation place for three years
opportunities.amount_note: Printed as HK$40,000 per year for up to four years of the normative study period, plus eligibility to apply for an additional performance-based scholarship of up to HK$60,000 per year. The same package includes a full tuition-fee waiver and a guaranteed hostel place for three years. This is a top-up, not the HKPFS monthly stipend.
opportunities.deadline_note: No separate deadline is printed. It applies to HKPFS awardees for the 2027/28 admission intake. The Lingnan HKPFS full-application deadline is 1 December 2026 (HKT 23:59).
opportunities.match_rationale: A local student who wins a Lingnan HKPFS place in the 2027/28 round could receive this top-up, including on a Data Science PhD. It is a scholarship and tuition waiver on top of the fellowship, not the monthly studentship itself, and it is only for HKPFS awardees.
opportunities.intake_relevance: Printed as applicable to HKPFS awardees for the 2027/28 admission intake.
restrictions: Only HKPFS awardees
Performance-based portion is an eligibility to apply, of up to HK$60,000 per year

restrictions: PhD only; MPhil students are not eligible to apply

Must be after confirmation of candidature

blockers: Lingnan has no Department of Mathematics or Computing Mathematics and no MPhil/PhD titled mathematics or computing mathematics. The open local research programme that publishes computational-mathematics topics is MPhil/PhD in Data Science. University-wide Postgraduate Studentships and HKPFS still apply to that programme.

Data Science research areas that were read include Applied mathematics and mathematical modelling, Numerical and computational mathematics, Numerical analysis and scientific computing, and Mathematical optimisation and convex / non-convex optimisation.
The Double PhD in Mathematics and Business is not an open local intake. Candidates are selected from Renmin University of China.

Stipend figures on the live financial-support, admission, HKPFS, and March 2026 PGS terms pages are labelled 2026/27. The open admission round is Direct Admissions (2027-28) and HKPFS (2027-28). No 2027/28 monthly stipend amount is printed. The October 2025 RPG guidebook still prints 2025-26 rates, including an HKPFS monthly stipend of HK$28,400, and those guidebook rates were not used.

An older prospectus PDF at https://www.ln.edu.hk/rpg/f/upload/114843/Lingnan_MPhil_PhD%20E-Prospectus_202526.pdf was returned in search. Its earlier stipend and tuition lines were not copied into opportunities. The prospectus index page is labelled 2026-27.
https://www.ln.edu.hk/orkt/research-funds/internal-grants/conferences-and-visits returned HTTP 403. Sino-British Fellowship Trust details are taken only from the October 2025 RPG guidebook.

The financial-support page says research postgraduate students are eligible for a number of other scholarships based on academic merit, and the e-handbook names University/Faculty/Department Scholarships/Prizes, without a public list of names or amounts. No scheme was invented for that heading.

The School of Data Science programmes page lists Master of Research in Advanced Data Science and a self-financed Doctor of Artificial Intelligence Studies, and several taught MSc programmes, without stating a studentship. No award row was created for them.

The OSA external-awards page lists many further schemes (Rhodes, MEXT, and others) that are not Lingnan research-postgraduate living stipends. Only the overseas Youde award and HKSES were recorded from that list, because they are easy to confuse with the local Youde fellowship.

The online admission system at https://apply.ln.edu.hk was not opened. Recorded terms come from public pages, so login_required is false. Application forms for conference sponsorship and overseas visits are public PDFs linked from the School of Graduate Studies financial-support index.
